name: Arihant Foundations and Housing
tagline: Rs5,000cr-GDV Prestige JV vs Rs928cr market cap — real momentum, unconfirmed catalyst, rising leverage
verdict_headline: Rs5,000cr-GDV Prestige JV dwarfs the current Rs928cr market cap, but it is unconfirmed and funded by a sharp recent rise in leverage
verdict_reasoning: Four-box score 3.5/4 (tailwind yes, TAM yes via the Padi JV, moat weak — JDA model, valuation yes at 13.6x vs a 24-56x peer range) supports the 10x-in-2-3-years label, but the headline catalyst is still pre-revenue — kept as an 'unconfirmed' live-inflection case per project convention, not a confirmed trend
FY25-26 is the first 2-year stretch clearing both revenue growth >=10% and ROCE >=15% simultaneously — a real but short (2-year) track record

Conviction raised to Medium (from Low-Medium): record pre-sales and marquee-investor backing are real positives, but the FY26 leverage jump (debt more than tripled) and margin volatility hold it below Medium-High until the Padi JV converts to actual bookings/launches
business_overview: Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd (AFHL) — Chennai-based residential/commercial real estate developer, incorporated 1992, listed on BSE (531381) and NSE (ARIHANT). ~95% of projects are executed via Joint Development Agreements (JDA) rather than outright land ownership. ~2.96 mn sqft under execution across 15+ projects (residential, commercial, senior housing, plotted). In 2026 entered a large-scale JV with Prestige Estates (Canopy Living LLP) for a 16.33-acre Padi (Chennai) land parcel, ~Rs5,000cr GDV potential.
fundamentals_narrative: AFHL's FY26 revenue nearly doubled to ~Rs420cr (consol) and pre-sales hit a record Rs513.70cr (+28% YoY), with Q1 FY27 pre-sales up a further 69% YoY — real, accelerating demand off a 15+ project, ~2.96mn sqft JDA pipeline. The headline development is a 2026 JV with Prestige Estates (Canopy Living LLP) for a 16.33-acre Padi land parcel carrying ~Rs5,000cr GDV potential — multiples of AFHL's own Rs928cr market cap — though it is still only at the land-acquisition/JV-formation stage with no disclosed launch date, pricing, or AFHL profit-share percentage. Funding this scale-up has come at a cost: borrowings more than tripled in FY26 (Rs149cr -> Rs478cr) against a net worth of only ~Rs371cr, and quarterly OPM has swung wildly (8%-31%) on project-completion-timing, with analysts independently flagging margin compression. A Rs109cr preferential allotment to marquee investors (Madhusudan Kela's Lotus Family Trust, CaratLane founders) in Nov-2024 diluted promoter holding from 42.87% to 37.29% — a one-time strategic capital raise, not a sell-down (pledge has stayed 0% throughout). Trades at 13.6x trailing P/E against a listed real-estate peer range of 24-56x, though AFHL is far smaller and less liquid than those peers.

four_box.note: Chennai residential/commercial upcycle (GCC-office demand, redevelopment, senior housing per management's own 5x-in-5-years roadmap) is structural. TAM yes: the Prestige/Padi JV alone (~Rs5,000cr GDV) is >10x AFHL's FY26 revenue base (Rs420cr) and several multiples of its Rs928cr market cap. Moat weak: 95% of projects are JDAs — Arihant doesn't own the underlying land, margins are project-based, and the main brand lift is from the Prestige association rather than a structural edge of its own. Valuation yes at 13.6x trailing P/E / ROE 17% vs listed peers at 24-56x P/E, though AFHL's far smaller scale/liquidity means a full discount-closing isn't realistic. Score 3.5 clears the four-box bar; kept as 10x-in-2-3-years (not overridden to neither) since a single transformative JV catalyst re-rating a Rs928cr-cap developer is a realistic category of outcome for this size/sector, unlike a deposit-funded bank — but the catalyst is still unconfirmed (land acquired, no launch yet), so conviction is capped accordingly.

track_record.note: FY23-FY26 checked (consolidated revenue growth >=10% AND ROCE >=15%): FY23 revenue -23% (fails growth), ROCE 9% (fails); FY24 revenue +94% (passes) but ROCE 11% (fails); FY25 revenue +66% (passes) and ROCE 20% (passes) — cleared; FY26 revenue +104% (passes) and ROCE 16% (passes) — cleared. FY25 and FY26 both cleared simultaneously as the Prestige-linked project pipeline scaled — a genuine 2-year inflection, not yet a 3+-year trend; FY23 was a pre-ramp, low-base year.
